title: Unit moved to column header
description: Drops the per-row "min" and states the unit once in the column header instead: "PRÓXIMA SALIDA (MIN)". Handles the hours row gracefully by keeping "1 h 4 min" spelled out on that one row, since a bare number would be ambiguous once the value crosses into hours — the header's implied unit only covers the common case.
baseline_ref: app/pages/index.vue board header (.screen__board-header span); app/components/ArrivalRow.vue eta formatting; .arrival-row__eta, .arrival-row__eta-unit

changes.intent: State the unit once at the column level so it doesn't need repeating on every row.
changes.detail: Change the second header span's text from 'Próxima salida' to 'Próxima salida (min)'.

changes.intent: Rows under an hour no longer need to restate the unit the header already declares.
changes.detail: For rows under 60 minutes (excluding 'ahora'/'SALIENDO'), render only the bare number in .arrival-row__eta and omit .arrival-row__eta-unit entirely (e.g. 3, 12).

changes.intent: The header's '(min)' doesn't apply once a value is in hours, so that row keeps explicit units to avoid misreading 1h4min as '1 min, 4 min' or similar.
changes.detail: The ≥60min branch is unchanged from baseline: renders '1' + .arrival-row__eta-unit('h') + '4' + .arrival-row__eta-unit('min'), fully spelled out regardless of the bare-unit rule applied to the other rows.
